conveneInfo.title: Convene System
conveneInfo.softPityDesc: Rate increases by ~6.6% per pull after pull 65. By pull 79, rate exceeds 90%.
conveneInfo.hardPityDesc: Guaranteed 5★ at pull 80. Average is ~71 pulls.
conveneInfo.guarantee4StarDesc: Base rate 6%. Independent from 5★ pity counter.
conveneInfo.fiftyFiftyDesc: 50% chance for the featured Resonator. Losing the 50/50 guarantees the featured Resonator on your next 5★ pull. Both pity counter and guarantee carry over to the next featured banner.
conveneInfo.noFiftyFiftyDesc: The featured weapon is guaranteed when you pull a 5★. Pity counter carries over to the next featured weapon banner.
conveneInfo.footerNote: Each banner type has its own independent pity counter
